//: Dalamud.NET.Sdk is pinned here rather than on the csproj's Sdk attribute. MSBuild asks for it
this way when a version is given at all, and Dependabot's nuget updater reads msbuild-sdks,
so a new Dalamud API level arrives as a pull request instead of as silence.
The major IS the API level the plugin publishes: it is a constant inside DalamudPackager, and
this pin decides which DalamudPackager runs. Dalamud only offers an update when the installed
and published levels match exactly, so a stale pin means nobody is ever told there is a newer
version. The release workflow refuses to publish when this disagrees with what Dalamud ships.
